title: NetworkAccountExportRequestedPayload
description: network.account.export_requested v1 (OpenVibe.Network; roadmap WS-B task 7, ADR-033). A person asked for a copy of their data. Each service that keeps data about people pushes its part before the deadline: POST /internal/account-exports/{export_id}/parts (network.account-export-part@1, capability network.account.export.contribute), with only the subject's own rows. A redelivery carries the same export_id; a second part from the same service replaces the first.

export_id.description: The export job; a redelivery carries the same id.

subject.description: The person whose data is exported.

deadline.description: Network builds the archive when every expected service has answered, or at this time (30 minutes after the request); a later part is refused.
